channel.title: Classroom SOTA Training — The Council of Elders
channel.description: Waldorf-style classroom training: a golden-youth pupil taught by a council of open-weights teachers via geometric-mean softmax consensus, the dream lane, and the constant AMA.

item.title: Eighteen voices: the council grows
item.description: The council is eighteen voices — six open-weight families plus vision and one thinking frontier (claude-opus-5). The consensus finally disagrees.

item.title: The classroom breathes
item.description: The dream lane streams dream.vaked.dev: inhale OM MANI PADME HUNG, exhale the DREAM state and an AMA about the pupil's dreams.

item.title: The pupil learns the whole constellation
item.description: The training corpus now includes the dyad's live Q&A, the constellation's knowledge (enthea, dyad-mapping), and the HF datasets — and its own dreams.
